evidence.text: Implemented vati_tax.workflows (rules/service/store/api) + Vati Workflow Version and Vati Workflow Activation DocTypes: TAX-064 proposals recorded unchanged as proposed versions (proposal digest + held-out evaluation kept), supervisor decisions with reason and holdout acknowledgement, append-only activation history with replaced_version and rollback_to references; every step and refusal sealed into the TAX-059 ledger. Observed 2026-11-05 in .venv-dev: 20 Frappe-free tests pass (workflows/test_service.py, including real TAX-064 propose_workflows output); full backend suite 319 tests OK (40 site-backed skipped); repo-wide mypy (169 files) and ruff clean. ADR-025.

Observed 2026-11-05 (python -m unittest workflows.test_service): self-approval refused via playbook.approve separation of duties, recorded as playbook.approve.denied and raising the repeated_separation_of_duties_attempts signal; officers/service cannot approve or activate; unapproved versions cannot be activated; check_execution refuses proposed/rejected (unapproved_version), inactive (not_active) and unknown versions and records each refusal; rollback re-activates the previous approved version and repeated rollbacks walk back v3->v2->v1. Mutation check: removing SoD, the approved-only or active-only execution check, or the rollback target each fails the suite.
